issues.what: Diagram SVG labels the correct answer layer with 'ERROR HERE', allowing pattern-matching without knowledge
issues.detail: The diagram shows the container runtime stack (kubelet -> CRI -> OCI Runtime -> Linux Kernel) and explicitly marks the OCI Runtime (runc) layer with '-- ERROR HERE' in a red-highlighted box. The correct answer (index 3) is 'The CRI (e.g., containerd) relaying an OCI runtime error from runc during pod sandbox creation'. A student can simply look at the diagram, see 'ERROR HERE' next to 'OCI Runtime (runc)', and select the only option mentioning OCI runtime and runc, without needing to understand the container runtime stack or parse the error message. The diagram should present the stack layers neutrally (without indicating which layer has the error) so students must analyze the error message text in the question stem to identify the correct layer.
issues.suggestion: Remove '-- ERROR HERE' from the OCI Runtime layer label in the SVG. Change it to just 'OCI Runtime (runc)' with the same neutral styling as other layers. The question stem's error message ('OCI runtime create failed') is sufficient for a knowledgeable student to identify the correct layer.
